description: This Java class 'DefaultKafkaConnectionFactory' implements a factory for creating Kafka producer instances, managing connection details and serializers for Kafka messaging within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultKafkaConnectionFactory
classes.description: A final class that implements the KafkaConnectionFactory interface, responsible for creating Kafka producer instances with specific connection settings.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance of DefaultKafkaConnectionFactory configured with the given connection and Kafka settings.

methods.name: connectionId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Kafka connection.

methods.name: newProducer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Kafka producer with the specified properties and serializers.
